versions.changelog:
Initial release of the medical-record-structuring skill:

- Converts unstructured Chinese clinical narratives (admission, progress, discharge, outpatient notes) into structured JSON aligned with HL7 FHIR R4 and Chinese EMR standards.
- Supports entity extraction for patient info, chief complaint, history, vitals, diagnoses (ICD-10), medication, procedures (ICD-9-CM-3), and lab results.
- Provides FHIR bundle output plus compliance with WS 445-2014 and related standards.
- Built-in PII masking, auditability, and low-confidence flagging for safe and transparent extraction.
- No clinical decision logic; strictly data structuring and code normalization.
- Includes batch, preview, and validation workflows; locally bundled dictionaries—no network required.
